title: npm run fast runs rule tests only when the diff touches what they scan
body:
Why: Qwen second audit N8: scripts/fast-check.ts:52,68 adds every test under test/rules/ to every run, a fixed tax on each slice.
Outcome: fast-check maps each rules test to the paths it scans and selects it only when the diff touches them; CI still runs all.
Proof: a fast-check test shows a src-only diff selects no prose rule tests and an AGENTS.md diff selects them; record before/after wall time of npm run fast on one small diff.
